abstract_sentences.text: Large language models can be steered at inference time through prompting or activation interventions, but activation steering methods often underperform compared to prompt-based approaches.

evidence.anchor: activation steering methods often underperform compared to prompt-based approaches

abstract_sentences.text: We propose a framework that formulates prompt steering as a form of activation steering and investigates whether distilling successful prompt steering behavior into simpler, interpretable models can close this gap.

evidence.anchor: distilling successful prompt steering behavior into simpler, interpretable models

abstract_sentences.text: Our analysis reveals that popular activation steering methods are not faithful to the mechanics of prompt steering, which applies strong interventions on some tokens while barely affecting others.

evidence.anchor: strong interventions on some tokens while barely affecting others

abstract_sentences.text: Based on these insights, we introduce Prompt Steering Replacement (PSR) models that estimate token-specific steering coefficients from the activations themselves and are trained to imitate prompt-based interventions.

evidence.anchor: estimate token-specific steering coefficients from the activations themselves

abstract_sentences.text: Experiments on three steering benchmarks across multiple language models show that PSR models outperform existing activation steering methods, especially when controlling for high-coherence completions, and also compare favorably to prompting on AxBench and persona steering.

evidence.anchor: outperform existing activation steering methods, especially when controlling for high-coherence completions

experimental_design.name: benchmark_scope
experimental_design.description: 实验覆盖 Persona Vectors、augmented IFEval format 与 AxBench 三个长文本 generation steering benchmark。

evidence.anchor: experiments on three benchmarks that evaluate steering long-form text generation

experimental_design.name: persona_data_construction
experimental_design.description: 每 trait 有 20 training questions、20 evaluation questions、5 positive/5 negative instructions；训练每 pair 采样 10 responses，得到 1000 positive 与 1000 negative triplets。

evidence.anchor: resulting in 1000 positive and 1000 negative triplets per trait for training

experimental_design.name: persona_judges_and_filtering
experimental_design.description: J_attr 判断 trait，J_coher 由 gpt-4.1-mini-2025-04-14 评分；coherence 和正负 trait 阈值用于过滤。

evidence.anchor: Instances with coherence < 0.5 are filtered out

experimental_design.name: persona_models_and_layers
experimental_design.description: Persona 使用 Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct、Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct、Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct；所有方法作用于 residual stream，单层位置按 Chen 或 Llama-3.2-3B 的 layer 16。

evidence.anchor: We ran persona steering experiments for three different LLMs

experimental_design.name: ifeval_scope
experimental_design.description: IFEval augmented set 含 12 类 format instruction 与 14 种同时有 train/test 的 language instructions。

evidence.anchor: format instructions of 12 different types and … 14 languages

experimental_design.name: ifeval_protocol
experimental_design.description: 跟随 Stolfo setup；J_attr 是 binary script，J_coher 适配非英语，steered response 使用 greedy decoding；非 prompt 方法按 judge 过滤。

evidence.anchor: generated using greedy decoding for all methods

experimental_design.name: axbench_scope
experimental_design.description: AxBench 使用 Gemma-2-2B-L20 与 Gemma-2-9B-L20；每 split 500 concepts，每 concept 72 train、5 validation、5 test triplets，response 由 frontier LLM 生成。

evidence.anchor: Each concept is associated with (x, x′, y′) triplets: 72 for training, 5 for validation, and 5 for testing

final_judgment.single_storyline: 论文把 prompting 重写为依赖 token 的 activation intervention，再用 activation-conditioned lambda 的 rank-1 PSR 蒸馏它；constant steering 的 equal-magnitude 假设被 token heatmap 诊断为过强，token-specific coefficient 同时承担机制近似与性能桥接作用（p.3–5、14–16）。
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 正文保留 Eq. (3) 的 prompt/activation bridge、Assumptions 3.1/3.2/3.2a、Eq. (7)–(8) 的 PSR、三 benchmark 的数据与指标、Tables 1–3、Figure 3，以及 IFEval failure 与 AxBench relevance trade-off 的范围化结论（p.3–9）。
final_judgment.appendix_moves: 层索引、coherence binary search、response-only/ConstMSE 全表、argument-free IFEval、judge breakdown、跨模型 RMSE 和 vector cosine 移入 Appendix C–G；正文保留方向，但复现单层结果、理解 IFEval 边界和解释 AxBench 增益都需要附录（p.22–30）。
final_judgment.best_pattern: 最有效的结构是 Figure 1 把 prompt intervention 变成可计算 activation difference，Figure 2 用 token strength 反例破坏 constant assumption，再以 Tables 1–3 的跨模型结果和 Figure 3 的 activation-level RMSE 双重闭环（p.3、8–9）。
final_judgment.largest_gap: rank-1 PSR 的 generality 依赖未经证明的单方向与 activation-decoded magnitude assumptions；IFEval 已暴露边界，但没有 low-rank extension、component deletion、随机性/成本或 adversarial robustness 的完整检验，因此 faithful steering 仍是条件性结论（p.4、7、9）。
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 要模仿黑盒行为，先在同一模型状态空间中定义可计算的 counterfactual intervention difference，再用 intervention-level 机制诊断和 output-level 结果分别验证；最终分数本身不能证明机制忠实（p.3 Figure 1、p.9 §5.2）。
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 该规则适用于能在同一 token/state trajectory 上恢复 counterfactual activations 的 steering/representation 方法；对只能观察最终文本、无法访问中间状态，或依赖多属性与 argument binding 的任务，rank-1 difference 不足以证明行为等价（p.3 footnote 5、p.6、p.7–9）。
